## Other

Between 2005 and 2023 I also published about a dozen conference papers, mostly on air pollution from transport, rural tourism and regional development. From 2012 to 2025 I published nearly 40 papers with tasks and results of the All-Russian Geography Olympiad, most of them in *Geografiya v shkole* and *Geografiya i ekologiya v shkole XXI veka*. Both groups are listed on [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0941-718X).
